pr_body:
Adds support for default start and end dates that includes entire range of dates that we can parse from year -9999 to year 9999. That should simplify the onboarding experience since if a user doesn't use datastreams they get a single index that covers all time ranges. 

Fixes #82832

Co-authored-by: weizijun <weizijun1989@gmail.com>
pr_title: TSDB: Fix time series bounds default value error

review_comment: Are `IndexSettings.TIME_SERIES_START_TIME` and `IndexSettings.TIME_SERIES_END_TIME` not required in the time_series index? I added the checking code to make these settings required. This is a requirement for the time_series index before. Now remove the check will change the requirement.  I think it's ok to make these settings not required, but we should check that if it satisfies the design of time_series index.
They are no longer required, but if they are not there we just use the default values.
It looks like if you leave it blank he's got it configured to cover -9999 to 9999. I wasn't super keen on having defaults for these a few months ago, but I suppose it's fine.
My preference would be to support an entire range from Long.MIN_VALUE to Long.MAX_VALUE but we are not capable of parsing such dates. This is the entire range we can parse.
